question_text: Students in Ms. Rivera's class want to see how different amounts of water affect how tall bean plants grow. They plan to: (1) Plant four bean seeds in four cups with the same kind of soil, (2) Put the cups on the same windowsill, (3) Give each cup a different amount of water every day, (4) Measure the height of the plants after three weeks. Which question is this investigation MOST likely trying to answer?
choice_a: Which plant grows the fastest in sunlight?
choice_b: How do different amounts of water affect plant growth?
choice_c: How many seeds will grow in each cup?
choice_d: What kind of soil do plants like best?

question_text: A student is watching birds at the school pond. Which statement is an observation rather than an opinion?
choice_a: The birds look beautiful when they fly.
choice_b: The birds like this pond more than other ponds.
choice_c: Four birds are sitting on the fence by the water.
choice_d: The birds seem happier when people are not nearby.

question_text: A class tests how far a toy car rolls down a ramp. They repeat the investigation three times using the same ramp and the same car each time. Why is it important that they repeat the investigation?
choice_a: So they can use more ramps in the future.
choice_b: So they can change their data if they do not like it.
choice_c: So other classes cannot copy their investigation.
choice_d: So they can check that their results are reliable.

question_text: A clear plastic cup is filled halfway with water and placed in a sunny window. After two days the water level is lower. Which process in the water cycle caused the water level to go down?

A student compares three samples: Sample A keeps its shape and can be held in her hand. Sample B takes the shape of any container it is poured into. Sample C spreads out to fill the entire room. Which row correctly matches each sample to its state of matter?
choice_a: A gas, B solid, C liquid
choice_b: A liquid, B gas, C solid
choice_c: A solid, B liquid, C gas
choice_d: A gas, B liquid, C solid

question_text: Luis pushes two boxes across the floor with the same force. Box X has a mass of 10 kilograms. Box Y has a mass of 5 kilograms. Which statement best describes what will happen?
choice_a: Box X will move faster because it is heavier.
choice_b: Box Y will move faster because it has less mass.
choice_c: Both boxes will move at the same speed.
choice_d: Neither box will move because the force is the same.

question_text: Cactus plants live in very dry environments. They have thick stems that store water and spines instead of leaves. How do these adaptations help cactus plants survive?
choice_a: The thick stems and spines allow the cactus to grow taller than other plants.
choice_b: The thick stems and spines help the cactus use more water than other plants.
choice_c: The thick stems store water and the spines protect the plant from animals.
choice_d: The thick stems and spines help the cactus make food without sunlight.
